description.value: Initially crafted by a gifted inventor who no longer had the use of their legs, the inventor's chair is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Traveler's Chair]. It's a marvel of engineering, utilizing clockwork mechanisms to maneuver about. The chair comes equipped with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wheel Blades], and portions of its frame contain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Artisan's Toolkit (Sterling)]{sterling artisan's tools}. The inventor's chair might be a family heirloom or a gift from someone who inherited it. It could instead sit unused in its inventor's abandoned estate, awaiting another user.
